description: Check whether the log is WELL WRITTEN — not what happened in the system: secrets or personal data printed, one line flooding the file, timestamps with no time zone (which make two machines impossible to correlate), the clock going backwards, everything at the same level, no request id, payload dumps, and orphan stack traces with no error line. Every finding comes with its count and a sample; secrets are masked.

format.description: Force the format instead of detecting it

from.description: Which end to read if the file is over 32 MB

path.description: Path to the log file. Use this for big logs: they do not fit in a tool call.

text.description: The log as text. Alternative to `path`.

name: log_lint
